scripts.generate-parser: peggy mask.peggy --format bare --extra-options '{"typescript":true}' --plugin peggy-ts -o ./index.ts && prettier index.ts --write
scripts.bundle-browser: echo 'import * as Mask from "./"; module.exports = Mask;' | esbuild --bundle --global-name=Mask --outfile=dist/index.js && prettier dist/index.js --write
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle-init; npm run bundle-cjs; npm run bundle-browser
scripts.prepare: npm run generate-parser; npm run bundle
scripts.verify: npm run lint; npm run check; npm test
